## Tidy Faculty_Salaries_1995.csv

```{r}
tidy_dat <- dat %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(AvgFullProfSalary, AvgAssocProfSalary, AvgAssistProfSalary,
             AvgFullProfComp, AvgAssocProfComp, AvgAssistProfComp,
             NumFullProfs, NumAssocProfs, NumAssistProfs),
    names_to = "Metric",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Rank = case_when(
      str_detect(Metric, "FullProf") ~ "Full",
      str_detect(Metric, "AssocProf") ~ "Associate",
      str_detect(Metric, "AssistProf") ~ "Assistant"
    ),
    Variable = case_when(
      str_detect(Metric, "Salary") ~ "Salary",
      str_detect(Metric, "Comp") ~ "Compensation",
      str_detect(Metric, "Num") ~ "Count"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-Metric) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Variable,
    values_from = Value
  ) %>%
  select(FedID, UnivName, State, Tier, Rank, Salary, Compensation, Count)

```

## Create Anova Table
```{r cars}
tidy_dat$Rank <- as.factor(tidy_dat$Rank)
tidy_dat$State <- as.factor(tidy_dat$State)
tidy_dat$Tier <- as.factor(tidy_dat$Tier)

anova_model <- aov(Salary ~ State + Tier + Rank, data = tidy_dat)

summary(anova_model)
```
## Tidy Juniper_Oils.csv
```{r}
dat_clean <- dat2 %>%
  rename_with(~ str_replace_all(., "\\.", "-"))

# Step 2: List of chemical columns
chemicals <- c("alpha-pinene","para-cymene","alpha-terpineol","cedr-9-ene","alpha-cedrene",
               "beta-cedrene","cis-thujopsene","alpha-himachalene","beta-chamigrene","cuparene",
               "compound-1","alpha-chamigrene","widdrol","cedrol","beta-acorenol","alpha-acorenol",
               "gamma-eudesmol","beta-eudesmol","alpha-eudesmol","cedr-8-en-13-ol",
               "cedr-8-en-15-ol","compound-2","thujopsenal")

# Step 3: Pivot longer to tidy format
dat_tidy <- dat_clean %>%
  select(SampleID, YearsSinceBurn, all_of(chemicals)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(chemicals),
               names_to = "Compound",
               values_to = "Concentration")
```
## Create a Graph
```{r}
ggplot(dat_tidy, aes(x = YearsSinceBurn, y = Concentration)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_smooth(se = TRUE, color = "blue", linewidth = 0.7, fill = "lightblue") +
  facet_wrap(~ Compound, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "Years Since Burn",
       y = "Mass-Spec Concentration",
       title = "Chemical Concentration vs. Time Since Burn") +
  theme_minimal()
```
## Use GLM model
```{r}
# Run GLMs for each chemical
glm_results <- dat_tidy %>%
  group_by(Compound) %>%
  do({
    model <- glm(Concentration ~ YearsSinceBurn, data = ., family = gaussian())
    tidy(model)
  })

# Filter for significant results
significant_chemicals <- glm_results %>%
  filter(p.value < 0.05) %>%
  select(term, estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value)

# View the results
significant_chemicals
```
